attributes.name: Laboratory Coat
attributes.powers:
Reveal this card to reduce all damage dealt to you by 1.

When you have a card that has the Alchemical trait in your hand and you are dealt a type of damage that matches a trait on that card, recharge that card and recharge this card to reduce that damage by 5.

Banish this card to reduce all damage dealt to you to 0; if proficient with light armors, you may bury it instead.
